name: fivem
description: Turns Claude Code into a FiveM developer. Stack-aware scaffolding, security + framework-purity auditing, server health checks, and ESX/QBCore → ox migration — grounded in real ox_lib, ox_core, ox_inventory and ox_target APIs rather than guessed ones. Detects whether your server runs ox, ESX, QBCore or QBox and speaks that dialect.

default_dialect.title: Preferred framework
default_dialect.description: Which dialect to write for greenfield work, when no server is detected. One of: ox, esx, qbcore, qbox, standalone. A detected server always wins over this.

default_server_path.title: Default server folder
default_server_path.description: The folder containing resources/, used when the current project has no detected server. Leave empty if you run more than one server — /fivem:init records the path per project instead.

audit_on_write.title: Audit Lua on write
audit_on_write.description: Lint resource Lua for security defects immediately after Claude writes it. Only CRITICAL and HIGH findings are surfaced.

beads.title: File findings as beads issues
beads.description: auto (only when the bd CLI and a beads database are both present), on, or off. Audit findings become tracked issues rather than chat output.
